Hi everyone, I'm Idis. I was at your clinic yesterday, and my dad let me use his phone so I can personally thank you for the wonderful treatment I received and, of course, the professionalism with which you treated me ❤️.
My dad also wants me to thank you for the explanations you gave us; that makes all the difference between a clinic and a good clinic like yours. Please keep up the good work 🙏
Thanks again ❤️

I've been going for eight years now, ever since I rescued my kittens and my dog, and I'm so happy. She's incredibly loving with them and has so much patience. I'll keep going forever. 100% recommended
They are very professional and pleasant to talk to, I definitely recommend them. I take all my pets to this vet and I always leave happy.
Thank you so much for the review 😊 …
I really liked the service, and the recommendation from the girl (whose name I don't remember) led us to stay here for a while, so she'll be our vet :)
Very kind, always looking after my little one.
I took my puppy to this vet and I'm delighted with them. They were very kind and attentive to everything. Thank you so much.
Thank you so much for your feedback!
I went for the first time because of an emergency with my puppy, and they attended to her super quickly and very well. I recommend them 100%.

It's truly a pleasure. As Amparo, the veterinarian, says, she's our puppy's pediatrician. She and Julia are wonderful. A great find for our little dog. Thank you so much for your attention and love for animals. I reiterate.
Excellent service. The grooming was very good. Everyone treated the pets with kindness. I recommend the clinic.

They've been treating our Golden Retriever for two years now, they're wonderful, and their diagnoses are always spot on. The costs are very reasonable.
They're very professional!

My cat died because of some pills (she only took two). I called them in the morning to say she wasn't feeling well, and instead of telling me to bring her to the emergency vet, they implied it wasn't a big deal and told me to bring her around 6:00 or 6:30 pm. They found her in a pool of urine mixed with blood. I called the vet immediately, and they told me it was impossible for the pills to have caused her death. I started researching them and saw that they can cause protein catabolism or adrenal insufficiency, which is most likely what happened because she was in a pool of urine and blood. I absolutely do not recommend this vet. They should have given me solutions from the moment I called them. It's my fault for trusting them and not going down to Valencia to take her to the emergency vet, but when someone who is supposed to KNOW something tells you this so casually, you don't expect it. Furthermore, the pills they sent us clearly state that they are for dogs, but since it's a professional, you don't take those things into account when giving them to them.
Excellent service, well-equipped clinic offering all kinds of services. Easy parking.

I want to share my painful experience with this veterinarian to prevent other pet owners from going through the same thing. My cat was in an accident and fractured his hip, requiring surgery. On the day of the accident, we rushed him to a 24-hour clinic, where they weighed him before administering any medication to ensure the correct dosage. My cat was stable when I decided to take him to our trusted veterinarian, Lynx.

I called to explain the situation, and they gave us an appointment despite being fully booked that day, which I appreciated. However, upon arrival, the veterinarian administered a morphine-derived medication without weighing my cat, meaning she couldn't calculate the correct dose.

Furthermore, the veterinarian seemed confused about when the accident had occurred, believing it was the previous night when it had actually been two days. The person who had spoken to me on the phone had to correct her. Although they were always kind to my cat, the veterinarian acted hastily due to the number of patients.

When we noticed my cat's temperature was dropping, instead of providing immediate treatment, the veterinarian suggested we take him to another clinic. We left with him, and he began breathing rapidly and became distressed, showing signs that could indicate a heart attack. Twenty minutes after we left, my cat passed away.

I am writing this review not only to express my grief but also to warn other pet owners about the risks they may face. I don't expect to get my beloved cat back, but I do hope this experience will encourage the clinic and its staff to be more careful and responsible in the future.

It is crucial that veterinary clinics act diligently and professionally at all times, as our pets depend on them for safe and appropriate care.
Super clean surgery with caring female vet. Empathetic with animals. Our dogs loved her and her receptionist. Speaks good English. Prices similar to UK.
Good service. Very knowledgeable staff. Speak good English. Good price highly recommend
